lines: 耶和华是我的力量，
是我的诗歌；他也成了我的拯救。
Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
耶和华是我的力量，
是我的诗歌；他也成了我的拯救。
耶和華是我的力量，
是我的詩歌；他也成了我的拯救。
Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.
我遭遇患难愁苦，你的命令却是我所喜爱的。
Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
我遭遇患难愁苦，你的命令却是我所喜爱的。
我遭遇患難愁苦，你的命令卻是我所喜愛的。
Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
Pain and trouble have overcome me: but your teachings are my delight.
但在你有赦免之恩，
要叫人敬畏你。
But there is forgiveness with you
therefore you are feared.

要叫人敬畏你。
但在你有赦免之恩，
要叫人敬畏你。
But there is forgiveness with you
therefore you are feared.
But there is forgiveness with you
so that you may be feared.
求你指教我遵行你的旨意，
因你是我的神。你的灵本为善；
求你引我到平坦之地。
Teach me to do your will
for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
求你指教我遵行你的旨意，
因你是我的神。你的灵本为善；
求你引我到平坦之地。
求你指教我遵行你的旨意，
因你是我的神。你的靈本為善；
求你引我到平坦之地。
Teach me to do your will
for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
Give me teaching so that I may do your pleasure; for you are my God: let your good Spirit be my guide into the land of righteousness.
因为我们作仇敌的时候，
且借着神儿子的死，
得与神和好；既已和好，
就更要因他的生得救了。
For if
while we were enemies
we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son
much more
being reconciled
we will be saved by his life.

且藉着神兒子的死，
得與神和好；既已和好，
就更要因他的生得救了。
For if
while we were enemies
we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son
much more
being reconciled
we will be saved by his life.
For if
when we were haters of God
the death of his Son made us at peace with him
much more
now that we are his friends
will we have salvation through his life;
因为知道我们的旧人和他同钉十字架，
使罪身灭绝，叫我们不再作罪的奴仆；
knowing this
that our old man was crucified with him
that the body of sin might be done away with
so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
因为知道我们的旧人和他同钉十字架，
使罪身灭绝，叫我们不再作罪的奴仆；
因為知道我們的舊人和他同釘十字架，
使罪身滅絕，叫我們不再作罪的奴僕；
knowing this
that our old man was crucified with him
that the body of sin might be done away with
so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
Being conscious that our old man was put to death on the cross with him
so that the body of sin might be put away
and we might no longer be servants to sin.
所以，时候未到，甚么都不要论断，
只等主来，他要照出暗中的隐情，
显明人心的意念。那时，
各人要从神那里得着称赞。
Therefore judge nothing before the time
until the Lord comes
who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness
and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

Therefore judge nothing before the time
until the Lord comes
who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness
and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
For this reason let there be no judging before the time
till the Lord comes
who will make clear the secret things of the dark
and the designs of the heart; and then will every man have his praise from God.
爱神的，也当爱弟兄，

This commandment we have from him
that he who loves God should also love his brother.
And this is the word which we have from him
that he who has love for God is to have the same love for his brother.
所以要约束你们的心，

be sober
and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

be sober
and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
So make your minds ready
and keep on the watch
hoping with all your power for the grace which is to come to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

Will give to me at that day: and not only to me

Come now
and let us have an argument together
says the Lord: how may your sins which are red like blood be white as snow? how may their dark purple seem like wool?
